status: candidate formal overlay pending independent review/CI/owner merge; NOT published or frozen. Schema-stage vectors (including the traffic-export schema and raw-body lexical cases) are executed by um/internal/schema/rev7_negative_vectors_test.go; semantic/platform/config-generation vectors require the implementation PR.
description: Negative and gating contract vectors for the rev-7 additive Linux read-only traffic observation. Each vector names its rejection stage: json_schema (executed by the contract conformance test), implementation_semantic (schema-valid but rejected by normative coherence/privacy/lexical rules), platform_isolation (rejected by authenticated node class), or config_generation (center emits/omits the key exactly as specified and the agent fails closed on invalid config). Most vectors use RFC 6901 JSON Pointers against a committed base body. Lexical rules cannot be represented by JSON Patch because JSON parsing normalizes numbers, so a vector may instead carry raw_body: the exact JSON bytes the implementation must feed. For raw_body vectors, json_schema stage means the schema must reject those bytes; implementation_semantic means the schema accepts them (documenting the schema limitation) and the implementation must reject the lexical form. The four CFG-REV7 cases encode the explicit agent-version gate (minimum agent.version 1.1.0); CFG-REV7-05 is the Windows/unknown-class case.
runner: um/internal/schema/rev7_schema_test.go (overlay compile + positive fixtures, including traffic-export.schema.json) and um/internal/schema/rev7_negative_vectors_test.go (json_schema stage, including raw_body lexical cases)

gating_rules.center_behaviour: The center tracks the latest agent.version received in a successfully authenticated signed snapshot. It MUST omit the collect.monitor_export key entirely (not emit false) while that version is unknown, missing or <1.1.0, even if the stored source-enable flag is set. Once a signed snapshot reports >=1.1.0, the stored source-enable flag becomes effective at the next config pull; no manual re-enable or extra handshake is needed. If a later signed snapshot reports an older version (agent rollback), the center MUST omit the key again on the next pull.
gating_rules.comparison: Compare the numeric major.minor.patch components of the frozen agent.version grammar: rev-7-capable iff major > 1 or (major == 1 and minor >= 1). Suffixes do not make an otherwise older build eligible. This is a compatibility gate, not an authorization or security boundary.
gating_rules.not_authorization: The version gate grants no privilege: the source still requires the versioned source audit, the operator/rollout gate, the linux_vps class and the applied config switch. An old agent cannot gain anything by misreporting a version; it would receive a config it rejects fail-closed.

vectors.mutation: exactness claims exact instead of lower_bound (exact/lower-bound ambiguity is forbidden)

expected.reason: exactness is const lower_bound; a lower bound must never be represented as an exact total

vectors.mutation: per-inbound lower-bound bytes are a fractional number (1234.5)

expected.reason: byte counters are integers; fractional observed bytes are rejected

vectors.mutation: byte counter is lexically a JSON float (1048576.0) even though its mathematical value is integral

expected.reason: JSON Schema treats 1048576.0 as an integer, so the center MUST additionally enforce canonical integer lexical form for byte/sequence/time fields (no '.', 'e' or 'E' token)

vectors.raw_note: JSON Patch cannot carry the lexical token 1048576.0 because a JSON parser normalizes it to the integer 1048576; the implementation must feed these exact raw bytes (this committed string) and reject the non-canonical integer token.

vectors.mutation: per-inbound lower-bound bytes are negative

expected.reason: observed counters are unsigned and cannot decrease below zero in one observation epoch

vectors.mutation: byte counter exceeds the 2^53-1 safe-integer bound

expected.reason: rev-7 byte counters are bounded to 9007199254740991 so every JSON consumer (including a JavaScript/front-end) sees the exact value; overflow must never wrap or be rounded by the implementation

vectors.mutation: source_epoch is uppercase hex instead of 32 lowercase hex characters

vectors.mutation: observation sequence is negative

vectors.scenario: CFG-REV7-01: the stored source-enable flag is set, but the node has no authenticated snapshot yet (agent.version unknown)

expected.center: MUST OMIT the collect.monitor_export key entirely (not false)
expected.reason: an unknown agent version is not rev-7 eligible; emitting the key to a rev-5 agent would be rejected by its strict config validator

vectors.scenario: CFG-REV7-02: the stored source-enable flag is set and the latest signed snapshot reports agent.version 1.0.0

expected.center: MUST OMIT the collect.monitor_export key entirely (not false)
expected.reason: 1.0.0 is below the rev-7 minimum agent.version 1.1.0; the key is withheld until an upgrade is reported

vectors.scenario: CFG-REV7-03: the stored source-enable flag is set and a signed snapshot has reported agent.version 1.1.0

expected.center: MUST INCLUDE collect.monitor_export=true in the next config pull (failure if absent)
expected.reason: the stored source flag becomes effective after the signed snapshot reports the minimum version; no manual re-enable or extra handshake is required

vectors.scenario: CFG-REV7-04: the latest signed snapshot reports agent.version 1.0.0 after a previous 1.1.0 snapshot (agent binary rollback)

expected.center: MUST OMIT the collect.monitor_export key again on the next pull
expected.reason: a downgraded/rolled-back agent must not receive rev-7 config; the center re-evaluates the latest signed version each pull
